_what: How a message that has not reached the account yet shows in its conversation (src/workspace/pending-lines.ts, drawn by the shared chat in src/workspace/messages-screen.tsx). The words are the person's own, shown at once as an optimistic echo from the device outbox (src/workspace/share-outbox.ts) with who-said-it reading `author`; Resend and Cancel are two ordinary message actions on that echo. `ref_prefix` is what marks an echo's reference so only echoes offer them.
author: You - waiting to send

cancel.label: Don't send
cancel.confirm: Throw this message away without sending it?

still_waiting: Still could not reach your account. It stays here and is sent again on its own.
gone: That message is no longer waiting.
